serverOnlyRule: Every environment variable without the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix is server-only, including feature flags and non-secret configuration.

notes.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY: Browser key by design; restrict it by HTTPS referrer and API in Google Cloud.
notes.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: Publishable key by design; authorization is enforced by RLS.
notes.NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: Stripe publishable key by design; never substitute a secret key.
notes.NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEMO_LOGIN: Public flag only; production code additionally requires NODE_ENV not to be production.
